question: Chhath Puja, the famous traditional festival of India is dedicated to which of the following Gods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhath Puja** is celebrated in the states of **Bihar, Jharkhand and UP**.
 
• The Festival is celebrated in the month of **Kartika of the Hindu lunar Bikram Sambat calendar**.
 
• It is a Hindu festival dedicated to the **Sun god and his wife Usha(Chhathi Maiya).**
 
• The prayers were offered by **Parvaitin**, which are usually women.
 
• It is believed, that **Pandavas and Draupadi** also performed the Puja to overcome obstacles in their lives.
